analysis: The PR changes documentation only: docs/provider/attestation.md (date bump at line 3; new paragraph at head lines 142-142 on App Attest serving versus MDM-removal readiness) and docs/provider/cli-reference.md (one bullet at head line 1025 with the same distinction). It contains no code, config or protocol changes. The new text matches the existing threat model. TB-011 and T-053/T-057 treat serving authorization (A-016, a bounded lease) as separate from removal and reward readiness, which needs a fresh coordinator decision. The added guidance tells operators to keep existing profiles installed and wait for a fresh decision when readiness is stale. That is conservative, and it does not weaken the 10-second freshness requirement in the existing unenroll paragraph (head line 144) or the rule that a local state-file rewrite cannot extend readiness. The text introduces no new trust claim, grant path or credential-deletion advice. Remaining unverified items: the referenced ../reference/provider-authorization.md and provider-swift/Sources/ProviderCore/Diagnostics/ProviderAuthorizationReadiness.swift (`summary`) are not in the supplied evidence. The claims that status and both doctor summaries use separate decisions, and that the serving lease can outlive removal readiness, are therefore unverified here. That is a documentation-accuracy question rather than a security regression. The ../reference/provider-authorization.md link may also not exist in this repo, since the neighbouring docs link to the platform repo. Unit 1ebf05eb42642970:0 is metadata only, with no content change visible. No threat-model update is needed.
